build_layer_stack: build a Haiku layer_stack that applies a Linear layer function N times with separate parameters per layer
test_layer_stack_multi_args: test a layer_stack function that takes multiple arguments and returns multiple outputs per layer
test_layer_stack_with_state: test a layer_stack that uses base.set_state to accumulate state across stacked layers
test_layer_stack_reverse: test a layer_stack run in reverse mode using the reverse keyword argument
test_layer_stack_transparent: test a transparent layer_stack with a custom LayerStackTransparencyMapping to match unrolled parameter names
